findings.headline: Manual upload test asserts a non-table label
findings.rootCause: The failing assertion is aimed at the wrong UI surface. “Subido manualmente” is a manual-upload/source filter label, while the Inbox invoice table renders only the configured invoice columns from `components/dashboard/sections/invoices/components/invoice-table/invoice-columns.ts:17`. That column set has no source/manual-upload column, and `components/dashboard/sections/invoices/components/search-filters.tsx:174` shows the label belongs to the source filter dropdown.
findings.whatHappened: The run reached the Inbox, opened the manual upload modal, selected a file, clicked “Subir”, and saw a success toast/loading transition. After refresh, the Inbox table showed its normal invoice rows, but the test failed because it searched those rows for “Subido manualmente”. Prior history has zero successful runs, so this generated test has no validated baseline.

The edit path shown in `lib/invoices/edit-invoice-service.ts:172-246` updates or revalidates invoice data but does not call duplicate detection or populate those warning fields, and the asserted Spanish sentence does not match the locale copy.
findings.whatHappened: The run reached the invoice detail page, entered `inv 2024 001`, and repeated clicks on “Guardar cambios” showed “Error al guardar los cambios.” No duplicate warning or “Revisar” button appeared. Prior runs show this test has never passed before.

findings.headline: Final assertion ignores the visible BankProvider connection error
findings.rootCause: The test’s final assertion only checks that “Connect your bank securely” is gone, which is true as soon as the Continue handler closes the dialog. In `components/dashboard/sections/connections/bank/add-bank-account.tsx:114-119`, the dialog is closed before `openBankProviderWebview()` runs; if that hook reports an error, `add-bank-account.tsx:105-110` renders the visible BankProvider error instead. Therefore the test can pass while the connection process fails to proceed.
findings.whatHappened: The run completed all steps: the BankProvider explainer dialog opened, showed the expected security copy, and closed on Cancel. On the final Continue action, the dialog closed but the app stayed on Connections and showed “No se pudo iniciar la conexión bancaria. Probá de nuevo.” There are no prior runs, so there is no baseline showing this continue-flow assertion was ever valid.

In the observed run, transaction rows were rendered, but the stats-derived total remained zero, so `transaction-table.tsx:70-72` and `transaction-table.tsx:132-138` produced `Mostrando 0-0 de 0 transacciones` while six rows were visible.
findings.whatHappened: The run reached the Transacciones page and exercised the search and flow-filter steps; the Acme Supplies row appeared and disappeared as expected. During the same run, the populated transactions table repeatedly displayed counters saying `0-0 de 0 transacciones`. Prior runs show this test has never passed before, so the written plan is not a reliable baseline, but the counter mismatch was a directly observed app issue.

evidence.detail: Final screen showed populated transaction rows while all visible range counters reported zero transactions.
The video showed the mismatch persisted while the table contents changed under filters.
The rebuilt table computes the displayed end index from totalTransactions, so a zero total forces the range to zero even when rows render.

After clicking “Continuar”, the app repeatedly showed “No se pudo iniciar la conexión bancaria. Probá de nuevo.” instead of the expected “Connecting…” state. Prior runs show this test has never passed before.
